package.description: The ultimate radio email client designed for seamless communication

en-US.description: The ultimate radio email client designed for seamless communication
en-US.longDescription:
Winlink Express is the ultimate radio email client designed for seamless communication. With its extensive features and support for the Winlink Hybrid Network, it stands out as the top choice by users. Whether you're operating with or without an internet connection, Winlink Express ensures reliable email delivery.
This user-friendly client is perfect for individuals with a single call sign or those needing to manage multiple addresses simultaneously. It offers compatibility with most transceivers, TNCs, and controllers, supporting a wide range of modes such as ARDOP, VARA HF and FM, Pactor, SCS Robust Packet, VHF/UHF AX.25 packet radio, WiFi, and any TCP/IP RF link. With Winlink Express, you can also connect directly to CMS servers or RMS Relay via internet/telnet, enabling high-speed communication across different networks.
Developed by the Winlink Development Team, Winlink Express prioritizes simplicity while leveraging advanced features. It employs the B2F extension radio transfer protocol, allowing attachments, multiple addresses, and tactical addresses. The client also features peer-to-peer connectivity, enabling direct RF connections to other Winlink Express or Airmail clients.
Winlink Express goes beyond email functionality, offering additional capabilities for emergency communications (EmComm). It supports HTML form creation, compact content transport, and a growing library of up-to-date forms. If you're considering using Winlink Express for EmComm, it's recommended to consult your local EmComm group for guidance and support.
en-US.name: Winlink Express

zh-CN.description: 专为无缝通信而设计的终极无线电电子邮件客户端
zh-CN.longDescription:
Winlink Express 是专为无缝通信而设计的终极无线电电子邮件客户端，凭借其丰富的功能和对 Winlink 混合网络的支持成为用户的首选。无论是否有互联网连接，Winlink Express 都能确保可靠的电子邮件传输。
这款用户友好型客户端非常适合使用单一呼号的用户或需要同时管理多个地址的用户。它与大多数收发器、TNC 和控制器兼容，支持多种模式，如 ARDOP、VARA HF 和 FM、Pactor、SCS Robust Packet、VHF/UHF AX.25 packet radio、WiFi 和任何 TCP/IP 射频链接。有了 Winlink Express，您还可以通过互联网/电信网直接连接到 CMS 服务器或 RMS Relay，从而实现不同网络间的高速通信。
Winlink Express 由 Winlink 开发团队开发，在充分利用先进功能的同时，优先考虑简便性。它采用 B2F 扩展无线电传输协议，允许附件、多地址和战术地址。该客户端还具有点对点连接功能，可与其它 Winlink Express 或 Airmail 客户端直接进行射频连接。
Winlink Express 不仅具有电子邮件功能，还提供用于应急通信（EmComm）的附加功能。它支持 HTML 表单创建、紧凑型内容传输和不断增加的最新表单库。如果您正在考虑将 Winlink Express 用于 EmComm，建议您咨询当地的 EmComm 小组，以获得指导和支持。
